capabilities: Search a local offline Japanese dictionary by written form, reading, or alternate form
Insert selected senses into notes via a configurable Markdown template
Render per-kanji furigana above kanji in Live Preview and Reading view
Generate vocabulary notes with an OpenAI-compatible AI provider and preview before inserting
extras: AI lookups send the entered term and selected prompt to the configured provider and can incur charges; dictionary lookups are local after installation. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up Japanese words from a local dictionary and insert vocabulary entries with per-kanji furigana as editable note content.

relations.evidence: Kotoba Insert renders {word|reading} itself, so no separate Furigana plugin is required.
inserting Japanese vocabulary from an offline JMdict-derived dictionary

summary: Japanese vocabulary lookup plugin that searches an offline JMdict-derived dictionary and inserts templated vocabulary notes with rendered furigana.
